# FAR 52.204-21 - Basic Safeguarding of Covered Contractor Information Systems

## Definitions

Covered contractor information system means an information system that is owned
or operated by a contractor that processes, stores, or transmits Federal
contract information.

Federal contract information means information, not intended for public release,
that is provided by or generated for the Government under a contract to develop
or deliver a product or service to the Government.

Federal contract information does not include information provided by the
Government to the public, such as on public websites, or simple transactional
information, such as necessary to process payments.

Safeguarding means measures or controls that are prescribed to protect
information systems.

## Basic Safeguarding Controls

The Contractor shall apply basic safeguarding requirements and procedures to
protect covered contractor information systems.

At a minimum, the controls include limiting information system access to
authorized users, processes acting on behalf of authorized users, or devices.

The controls include limiting information system access to the types of
transactions and functions that authorized users are permitted to execute.

The controls include verifying and controlling or limiting connections to and
use of external information systems.

The controls include controlling information posted or processed on publicly
accessible information systems.

The controls include identifying information system users, processes acting on
behalf of users, or devices, and authenticating their identities before allowing
access.

The controls include sanitizing or destroying information system media
containing Federal Contract Information before disposal or release for reuse.

The controls include limiting physical access to organizational information
systems, equipment, and operating environments to authorized individuals.

The controls include escorting visitors and monitoring visitor activity,
maintaining audit logs of physical access, and controlling physical access
devices.

The controls include monitoring, controlling, and protecting organizational
communications at external boundaries and key internal boundaries.

The controls include implementing subnetworks for publicly accessible system
components that are physically or logically separated from internal networks.

The controls include identifying, reporting, and correcting information and
information system flaws in a timely manner.

The controls include providing protection from malicious code at appropriate
locations, updating malicious code protection when new releases are available,
and performing periodic scans and real-time scans of files from external
sources.

## Other Requirements

This clause does not relieve the Contractor of any other specific safeguarding
requirements specified by Federal agencies and departments.

It also does not relieve the Contractor of Federal safeguarding requirements for
controlled unclassified information established by Executive Order 13556.

## Subcontracts

The Contractor shall include the substance of this clause, including the
subcontracts paragraph, in subcontracts under this contract.

The flowdown applies to subcontracts in which the subcontractor may have Federal
contract information residing in or transiting through its information system.
